lines.en: label day264:
scene karincat1
On a bench, sits a girl...
lines.zh: 长椅上，坐着一个女孩……

lines.en: And beside that girl, a cat.
lines.zh: 女孩旁边，是一只猫。

lines.en: Beside the cat, the grass.
lines.zh: 猫的旁边，是草地。

lines.en: And underneath the grass, things we can not fathom.
lines.zh: 而草地之下，是我们无法理解的东西。

lines.en: If I had to take a guess, I’d probably say dirt.
lines.zh: 非要我猜的话，大概是泥土。

lines.en: Dirt and worms.
lines.zh: 泥土和虫子。

lines.en: Things this girl and her sister likely played with in their backyard before they grew up and it became less socially acceptable to do things of that nature.
lines.zh: 这女孩和她妹妹大概小时候在后院玩过这些东西，后来长大了，玩这种事就不再被社会所接受了。

lines.en: Now, instead of burying her fingers in the earth, she buries them into the fabric of her cardigan.
lines.zh: 如今她不再把手指埋进土里，而是埋进了毛衣的布料里。

lines.en: And the younger one, the one who is not here, buries hers in something else.
lines.zh: 而那个小的、不在这里的那个，则把手指埋进了别的东西里。

lines.en: : Alone today?
lines.zh: : 今天一个人？

lines.en: scene karincat2
: I...I have pepper spray!
lines.zh: : 我……我有防狼喷雾！

lines.en: scene karincat3
: Oh...It’s you.
lines.zh: : 哦……是您。

lines.en: : Sorry, Sensei. I was just lost in thought for a moment.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Sensei。我只是刚刚有点走神。

lines.en: : And I don’t actually have pepper spray. You’re safe.
lines.zh: : 而且我其实没有防狼喷雾。您很安全。

lines.en: : You probably should. That seems like a vital item for all [teenage]girls to carry.
lines.zh: : 你大概该备一个。那似乎是所有[teenage]女生都该随身携带的重要物品。

lines.en: : And you’ve certainly got enough bag space for it.
lines.zh: : 而且你的包空间肯定够放。

lines.en: : Bag...space?
lines.zh: : 包……空间？

lines.en: scene karincat4
: Oh, yeah. {i}These{/i} bags.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。{i}这些{/i}袋子。

lines.en: : They’re not really mine. I’m just going to be hanging some fliers to try and recruit new members for the soccer team.
lines.zh: : 其实不是我的。我正要去贴些传单，为足球队招新成员。

lines.en: : In the middle of winter? And all by yourself?
lines.zh: : 大冬天的？还一个人？

lines.en: scene karincat5
: Kirin was supposed to come, but I’m pretty sure she’s still mad at me for telling her to watch her language last week.
lines.zh: : 本来 Kirin 要来的，但我敢肯定她还在生上周我让她注意言辞的气。

lines.en: : Still? I could have sworn she was going to apologize to you.
lines.zh: : 还在生气？我还以为她会跟你道歉呢。

lines.en: : Kirin? Apologizing? I figured you’d know her better than that by now.
lines.zh: : Kirin？道歉？我以为您到现在已经够了解她了。

lines.en: : I doubt it. I’ve definitely gotten to know her a little better, but I still don’t understand the first thing about her.
lines.zh: : 不见得。我确实对她了解了一点，但我还是连她最根本的一点都没搞懂。

lines.en: scene karincat6
: Yeah...she’s kind of hard to gauge. You’ll get the hang of it eventually.
lines.zh: : 嗯……她是挺难摸透的。您迟早会习惯的。

lines.en: : Especially since she...did all of that stuff just to wind up in your class.
lines.zh: : 尤其是她……为了进您的班还做了那么多事。

lines.en: : If you’re talking about causing trouble or whatever it was she said she did, it was a lot more simple than that.
lines.zh: : 如果你说的是惹麻烦、还是她自称做过的什么，其实比那简单多了。

lines.en: : She probably just asked for a transfer the normal way, right?
lines.zh: : 她大概就是正常申请了转班吧？

lines.en: : Oh, wow. You didn’t even have to wait for her to slip up and say it on accident to figure that out.
lines.zh: : 哦，哇。你都不用等她说漏嘴就猜到了。

lines.en: scene karincat7
: When you grow up sharing a bedroom with someone, you kind of learn their habits and tendencies and stuff.
lines.zh: : 从小跟一个人共用一间卧室长大，你多少会摸清她的习惯、脾性什么的。

lines.en: : Also, if she ever told you I talk in my sleep, she’s lying.
lines.zh: : 还有，要是她跟您说我睡觉会说梦话，那是她撒谎。

lines.en: : I stopped doing that like six years ago and after I found out, I was so embarrassed I didn’t leave the room for like three days.
lines.zh: : 我大概六年前就不这样了，而且我发现之后羞得整整三天没出房门。

lines.en: : I will be sure to write that next to your name in my diary.
lines.zh: : 我一定会把这条写在日记里你名字旁边。

lines.en: scene karincat8
: You...you write about me in your diary?!
lines.zh: : 您……您在日记里写我？！

lines.en: : What? No. Obviously, that was a joke.
lines.zh: : 什么？不是。那明显是开玩笑。

lines.en: scene karincat9
: Y...Yeah! I knew that!
lines.zh: : 那、那是！我当然知道！

lines.en: : Obviously you’d never write about me in your diary. You’d save that for all of the girls you’re closer to and-
lines.zh: : 您显然不会在日记里写我。那种待遇是留给您关系更亲密的女生的——

lines.en: : Karin, I don’t have a diary at all.
lines.zh: : Karin，我根本没有日记本。

lines.en: scene karincat10
: Just pretend I’m not here. I’m clearly not ready for this.
lines.zh: : 就当我不在这儿吧。我显然还没准备好。

lines.en: : Ready for what? We’re just talking.
lines.zh: : 准备好什么？我们只是在聊天。

lines.en: : That. I’m not ready to talk.
lines.zh: : 就是这个。我还没准备好聊天。

lines.en: : But we’ve talked several times now. We even went to the cafe together once.
lines.zh: : 可我们已经聊过好几次了。我们还一起去过一次咖啡店。

lines.en: : You also made me cookies. And they were great, by the way.
lines.zh: : 你还给我做了饼干。顺便说一句，非常好吃。

lines.en: scene karincat11
: You...ate them?
lines.zh: : 您……吃了？

lines.en: : That is...what I was supposed to do with them, wasn’t it?
lines.zh: : 那不是……我本来就该那么处理吗？

lines.en: : I kind of expected you to just throw them in the garbage since it was probably really creepy getting cookies from some girl you barely even know.
lines.zh: : 我还以为您会直接扔进垃圾桶，毕竟收到一个您几乎不认识的女生送的饼干，大概挺瘆人的。

lines.en: : Well, I’m glad I didn’t. You should make me more sometime.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我很高兴我没扔。你有空该再给我做点。

lines.en: scene karincat12
: I will go home right now and make you a bunch more!
lines.zh: : 我现在就回家给您做一大堆！

lines.en: : Just do it when you have time...
lines.zh: : 有空再做就好……

lines.en: : I have plenty of time! My sister ditched me!
lines.zh: : 我有的是时间！我妹妹放我鸽子了！

lines.en: : Don’t say such depressing things with a smile that wide, please. It makes me uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 别挂着那么大的笑容说这么丧的话好吗。我浑身不自在。

lines.en: : Am I smiling? I’m...I’m totally not smiling on purpose if I’m smiling. What even {i}is{/i} a smile? Like...right?
lines.zh: : 我在笑吗？如果我在笑，那我……我绝对不是故意笑的。笑到底{i}是{/i}什么东西？就是……对吧？

lines.en: scene karincat10
: You can go back to pretending I’m not here now.
lines.zh: : 您现在可以继续当我不存在了。

lines.en: : In fact, I would probably prefer things that way.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我大概更希望那样。

lines.en: : You’re doing great. Just think of communicating with me like...a sport or something.
lines.zh: : 你做得很好。就把跟我交流想象成……一项运动什么的。

lines.en: : Ugh...how does Kirin do it so easily?
lines.zh: : 呃……Kirin 怎么就能这么轻松？

lines.en: : Do what? Talk to me?
lines.zh: : 做什么？跟我说话？

lines.en: scene karincat13
: Y-Yeah.
lines.zh: : 是、是啊。

lines.en: : Any time I see her talking to you, her eyes get all wide and she says all this stuff she’d never even come close to saying at home.
lines.zh: : 每次我看见她跟您说话，她眼睛就睁得老大，说一堆在家里绝对说不出口的话。

lines.en: : She’s like, a total recluse there. She never even eats dinner with us and when she {i}does{/i}, she barely says a word.
lines.zh: : 她在家里简直就是个隐士。她连晚饭都不跟我们一起吃，就算{i}吃了{/i}也几乎一句话不说。

lines.en: : But with you she’s all like, “Aaaaaaaaaaaah!”
lines.zh: : 可跟您在一起，她整个人就是「啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！」

lines.en: : You know?
lines.zh: : 您懂吧？

lines.en: : I think there was a more eloquent way that could have been worded, but I get it for the most part.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这话本来可以表达得更文雅一点，不过我大体懂了。

lines.en: scene karincat14
: It probably sounds silly but...I want to do that too...
lines.zh: : 听起来可能很傻，不过……我也想那样……

lines.en: ka "I want to see you at the park we normally visit and be able to...actually hold a conversation without my heart feeling like it’s going to rip its way out of my chest and run
lines.zh: 我想在我们常去的那个公园见你，能……真正地聊一次天，而不是感觉心脏要从胸口里撕开一条路逃出去，

lines.en: off to join the circus."
lines.zh: 跑去加入马戏团。

lines.en: : I don’t think there are many circus openings in Kumon-mi. Let alone ones that would accept disembodied organs.
lines.zh: : 我觉得 Kumon-mi 没多少马戏团在招人。更别说会收离体器官的了。

lines.en: scene karincat15
: Then I shall carry it there in the container that is my body and accept my new role in life as a trapeze artist.
lines.zh: : 那我就用我这副身体当容器把它带过去，接受我人生的新角色——空中飞人。

lines.en: scene karincat16
: But I’m kind of afraid of heights, so I’m hoping they start me off with an easier job.
lines.zh: : 不过我有点恐高，所以希望他们先给我安排个简单的活儿。

lines.en: : As long as it’s not anything like cleaning the elephant pens or...talking to clowns, I think I’ll do okay.
lines.zh: : 只要不是打扫大象圈之类的……或者跟小丑说话，我觉得我都能行。

lines.en: : I’ve heard that circuses don’t pay very well, but living on the road sounds nice and-
lines.zh: : 我听说马戏团工资不高，但在路上生活听起来挺不错的——

lines.en: : Karin.
lines.zh: : Karin。

lines.en: scene karincat17
: Oh my god. You hate me now, don’t you? I’m so sorry.
lines.zh: : 我的天哪。您现在讨厌我了，对吧？非常抱歉。

lines.en: : I have literally no idea what I’m doing.
lines.zh: : 我真的完全不知道自己在干什么。

lines.en: : Are we still at[school]?
lines.zh: : 我们还在[school]吗？

lines.en: : We are...
lines.zh: : 在的……

lines.en: : In fact, how long have you been waiting for Kirin to show up? I’m already done with my office hours, so I figured you’d have been long gone by now.
lines.zh: : 话说回来，你等 Kirin 多久了？我的坐班时间都结束了，我还以为你早就走了。

lines.en: : I don’t know. Two hours, maybe?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。大概两个小时？

lines.en: : You’ve been waiting for her for two hours?...
lines.zh: : 你等了她两个小时？……

lines.en: That is extremely sad.
lines.zh: 这实在太惨了。

lines.en: But also...why wait out here?
lines.zh: 不过话说回来……为什么要在这外面等？

lines.en: It’s freezing and she’s only like fifty feet from the entrance to the[school].
lines.zh: 天冻得要命，而她离[school]门口也就五十英尺。

lines.en: scene karincat18
: Well...
lines.zh: : 那个……

lines.en: : I was waiting for her at first, but...
lines.zh: : 我一开始是在等她，不过……

lines.en: : Then I thought I might...catch you leaving instead.
lines.zh: : 后来我想……也许能碰上您下班。

lines.en: : And there’s been something kind of bothering me that...I wanted to ask you about.
lines.zh: : 而且有件事一直让我有点在意……我想问问您。

lines.en: : If that’s the case, you should have just come to my office. That would have been a lot easier than waiting for me out here.
lines.zh: : 既然这样，你直接来我办公室不就好了。那比在外面等我容易多了。

lines.en: : But what if in the window of time it took me to get to your office, you happened to walk down a different flight of stairs?
lines.zh: : 可万一在我走到您办公室的这段时间里，您恰好走了另一段楼梯呢？

lines.en: : Then, without knowing, we’d pass each other...fated to always be just several steps away and looking out for the other as we drift further apart than ever before.
lines.zh: : 那我们就会在毫不知情的情况下擦肩而过……命中注定永远只差几步，都在寻找对方，却比以往任何时候都隔得更远。

lines.en: : Okay, sure. But I wouldn’t really be looking for you, so...
lines.zh: : 好吧，行。不过我又不会真的去找你，所以……

lines.en: scene karincat19
: Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: : What do you think of my sister?
lines.zh: : 您觉得我妹妹怎么样？

lines.en: : What do I think of Kirin?
lines.zh: : 你是说我觉得 Kirin 怎么样？

lines.en: : I think that she’s obnoxiously difficult to figure out. And that a lot of that comes from her not fully understanding herself.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她难懂得要命。而这很大程度上是因为她自己都没完全搞懂自己。

lines.en: : I don’t mean as a person...
lines.zh: : 我不是说作为一个人……

lines.en: : I mean as a...g...girl...
lines.zh: : 我是说作为……女、女孩……

lines.en: : You get nervous when saying the word “girl” now, too?
lines.zh: : 你现在连说「女孩」这个词都会紧张？

lines.en: scene karincat20
: I get nervous with every word when you’re around! I can’t help it!
lines.zh: : 您在旁边的时候，我说每个字都紧张！我也没办法！

lines.en: : Is there a reason you’re asking me this all of a sudden?
lines.zh: : 你突然问这个，是有原因的吧？

lines.en: : Of course there’s a reason...it’s just...
lines.zh: : 当然有原因……只是……

lines.en: scene karincat21
: It’s just even harder to say than...all of the other stuff that I have a hard time saying...
lines.zh: : 只是这比其他所有我难以启齿的事……更难说出口……

lines.en: The cat beneath us and beside the grass looks up at Karin.
lines.zh: 我们脚下、草地旁边的那只猫抬头看着 Karin。

lines.en: They say that cats can be good devices for calming people down, but no matter how hard this one stares at her, her hands remain trembling.
lines.zh: 人们说猫是让人平静下来的好工具，但不管这只猫多用力地盯着她，她的手还是在抖。

lines.en: It could just be from the cold, but that’s unlikely.
lines.zh: 也许只是因为冷，但不太像。

lines.en: I know what she’s asking.
lines.zh: 我知道她想问什么。

lines.en: She’s probably been worried about it for a while given how closely she’s observed Kirin’s mannerisms around me-
lines.zh: 考虑到她观察 Kirin 在我身边的举止观察得那么仔细，她大概已经担心这件事有一阵子了——

lines.en: But that “joke” her sister said the other day about fucking her teacher has likely been lingering in the back of her mind ever since.
lines.zh: 但她妹妹前几天那句要操自己老师的「玩笑」，大概从那时起就一直萦绕在她心底。

lines.en: And she won’t feel better until she knows that nothing like that is going on.
lines.zh: 在确定没有那种事之前，她是不会安心的。

lines.en: She’s a good sister.
lines.zh: 她是个好姐姐。

lines.en: {s}I wish I had someone like that.{/s}
lines.zh: {s}我真希望也有人这样对我。{/s}

lines.en: : I g...guess what I’m...a...asking is if...
lines.zh: : 我……我想……问、问的是……

lines.en: : You see her as more than just...another student...
lines.zh: : 您有没有把她看得……不只是一个学生……

lines.en: : Because...l...like...
lines.zh: : 因为……就、就像……

lines.en: scene karincat22
: I’m so sorry...It’s probably unbelievable how I’m even...s...suggesting such a thing...
lines.zh: : 非常抱歉……我居然会……暗、暗示这种事，大概难以置信吧……

lines.en: : It’s just...a weird side of her I’ve never seen before and...and I want to understand and...
lines.zh: : 只是……她身上有一面我从来没见过的奇怪样子，而……而我想弄明白，而且……

lines.en: : I’m worried...that you...
lines.zh: : 我担心……您……

lines.en: : That I’m too old for her?
lines.zh: : 担心我对她来说太老了？

lines.en: scene karincat23
: N-N-N-N-N-No! That’s not it at all!
lines.zh: : 不、不、不、不、不是！完全不是那样！

lines.en: : I don’t think you’re old! I think you’re a great age! The best age!
lines.zh: : 我不觉得您老！我觉得您的年纪好极了！是最好的年纪！

lines.en: : I...I’m worried for a different reason!
lines.zh: : 我……我担心的是别的原因！

lines.en: : And what reason might that be, Karin?
lines.zh: : 那是什么原因呢，Karin？

lines.en: : A reason I can’t possibly say out loud!
lines.zh: : 一个我绝对说不出口的原因！

lines.en: (She loves me.)
lines.zh: （她爱我。）

lines.en: scene karincat24
: I just...can’t stop thinking about it and...
lines.zh: : 我只是……忍不住一直想着这件事，而且……

lines.en: : And I know she’ll never say anything to me, so...
lines.zh: : 而且我知道她永远不会跟我说这些，所以……

lines.en: : I wanted to know if...anything was...happening with...you two.
lines.zh: : 我想知道……您们两个之间……有没有发生什么。

lines.en: : I’m so sorry, Sensei...I know it’s not true, but...I need to hear it with my own ears or...
lines.zh: : 非常抱歉，Sensei……我知道那不是真的，可是……我需要亲耳听到，不然……

lines.en: : Or I won’t be able to stop thinking about things that make my heart beat even harder than it normally does around you.
lines.zh: : 不然我就没法不去想那些事，那些会让我的心跳得比平时在您身边时还要厉害的事。

lines.en: : And I need my heart. It’s the most important organ in my body.
lines.zh: : 而且我需要我的心脏。它是我身体里最重要的器官。

lines.en: : And it has a huge career ahead of itself in the circus as a trapeze artist and-
lines.zh: : 它作为空中飞人在马戏团还有大好前程——

lines.en: : Karin, calm down.
lines.zh: : Karin，冷静点。

lines.en: : Kirin’s my little sister, Sensei. To protect her, I need to know what she’s getting into and...
lines.zh: : Kirin 是我妹妹，Sensei。为了保护她，我得知道她卷进了什么，而且……

lines.en: : And I need to know...who she’s...
lines.zh: : 我还得知道……她在跟谁……

lines.en: I sigh to myself and search for a small pile of snow to kick up.
lines.zh: 我暗自叹了口气，想找一小堆雪踢一脚。

lines.en: Unfortunately, there’s none around today and I suddenly find myself kicking the air and looking either very confused or flat-out weird.
lines.zh: 不巧今天周围一点雪都没有，于是我突然发现自己在踢空气，看起来要么非常困惑，要么就是彻底的怪人。

lines.en: There’s no easy way to answer this.
lines.zh: 这个问题没有容易的回答方式。

lines.en: I either tell her the truth about the relationship between Kirin and me, breaking her poor little heart while providing her much needed solace...
lines.zh: 我要么告诉她我和 Kirin 之间关系的真相，虽然给了她急需的安慰，却也伤了她那颗可怜的小心脏……

lines.en: Or-
lines.zh: 要么——

lines.en: I lie about everything and hope she’s gullible enough to believe someone twice her age, yet ten times more lost than she’ll ever be.
lines.zh: 要么把所有事都瞒下来，指望她足够好骗，去相信一个年纪是她两倍、却比她迷茫十倍的人。

lines.en: Decisions, decisions.
lines.zh: 真是艰难的抉择。

lines.en: : Sensei...are you...{i}involved{/i} with Kirin?...
lines.zh: : Sensei……您和 Kirin……{i}有那种关系{/i}吗？……

lines.en: : That’s...the only way I can word it without wanting to pull my hands off and feed them to this little kitty.
lines.zh: : 这……是我唯一能说出口的说法了，再说下去我就想把自己的手扯下来喂给这只小猫。

lines.en: : How would you even pull the second-
lines.zh: : 你要怎么把第二只——

lines.en: : You know what? Never mind.
lines.zh: : 算了。当我没说。

lines.en: : Karin-
lines.zh: : Karin——

lines.en: menu:
I’m not interested in her
lines.zh: 我对她没兴趣

lines.en: : I don’t see Kirin that way.
lines.zh: : 我对 Kirin 没有那种看法。

lines.en: : She’s a cute girl and...she's nice, I guess?
lines.zh: : 她是个可爱的女孩，而且……人也不错吧？

lines.en: : But there’s no way I’d ever be romantically interested in her.
lines.zh: : 但我绝不可能对她产生那种感情。

lines.en: I start saying the first things that come to mind.
lines.zh: 我开始把脑子里冒出来的第一句话往外说。

lines.en: Things that Karin would be sure to believe given her inherent understanding of the girl we’re talking about.
lines.zh: 都是些 Karin 一定会相信的话，毕竟她天生就了解我们正在谈论的这个女孩。

lines.en: But I have no idea how much, if any of it, she’ll believe.
lines.zh: 但我不知道她会信多少，甚至会不会信。

lines.en: I don't even know if any of what I'm saying is true.
lines.zh: 我甚至不知道自己说的到底有没有一句是真的。

lines.en: Kirin and I have already crossed a line together that...
lines.zh: 我和 Kirin 早已经一起越过了一条线，那条线……

lines.en: Well-
A line that would probably make her sister cry.
lines.zh: 一条大概会让她姐姐哭出来的线。

lines.en: And I don’t want to make Karin cry.
lines.zh: 而我不想让 Karin 哭。

lines.en: So I lie through my teeth and hope she eats up every single, dishonest word I have to say.
lines.zh: 所以我睁着眼睛说瞎话，指望她把我说的每一个不诚实的字都照单全收。

lines.en: scene karincat25
: God...I am...{i}SO{/i}...so happy to hear that.
lines.zh: : 天哪……我……{i}真{/i}、真的太高兴听到您这么说了。

lines.en: Dishonesty reigns supreme.
lines.zh: 不诚实大获全胜。

lines.en: I fall closer to happiness and further from pure morality all at once.
lines.zh: 我离幸福更近了，同时也离纯粹的道德更远了。

lines.en: scene karincat26
: To be honest, I was...kind of worried that maybe it was already a little too late...but...
lines.zh: : 说实话，我……有点担心也许已经有点太晚了……不过……

lines.en: : But now I’m feeling...a lot better.
lines.zh: : 但现在我感觉……好多了。

lines.en: : And...and that also means that...
lines.zh: : 而且……而且那也意味着……

lines.en: : That maybe there’s...hope for...
lines.zh: : 也许……还有……希望……

lines.en: scene karincat27
: I’m...I’m gonna go, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 我……我先走了，Sensei！

lines.en: : I suddenly have this crazy urge to run and...and I want to make sure I have time to finish my homework and...
lines.zh: : 我突然特别想跑起来，而且……而且我想确保有时间把作业写完，还有……

lines.en: : And there are...fliers and...um...
lines.zh: : 还有……传单什么的……呃……

lines.en: : Uhh...
: Bye! And thank you!
lines.zh: : 再见！还有谢谢您！

lines.en: : Thank you so much!
lines.zh: : 真的非常感谢您！

lines.en: scene karincat28
Karin grabs everything near her (Including the cat) and presses it all against her chest as she runs away.
lines.zh: Karin 抓起身边所有的东西（包括那只猫）紧紧抱在胸前，跑了出去。

lines.en: A soft meow can be heard fading from earshot.
lines.zh: 一声轻柔的喵叫渐渐远去，听不见了。

lines.en: : What exactly was she thanking me for?
lines.zh: : 她到底在谢我什么？

lines.en: scene black
{i}Congratulations! You are a liar!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}恭喜！你是个骗子！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Let’s hope Karin never finds out you came in her sister’s mouth!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}但愿 Karin 永远都不会发现，你射在了她妹妹嘴里！{/i}

lines.en: $ karinlied = True
$ day264 = True
$ karin_love += 1
{i}Karin’s affection has increased to [karin_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Karin 的好感度提升到了 [karin_love]！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Maybe one day, you’ll get to cum in her mouth as well!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}也许有一天，你也能射进她嘴里！{/i}

lines.en: jump afterschoolevent
I’m already involved with her
lines.zh: 我已经和她有关系了

lines.en: : I’m going to be completely honest.
lines.zh: : 我会完全诚实地说。

lines.en: : All of those things you’re worried about-
lines.zh: : 你担心的那些事——

lines.en: : Chances are they’ve already happened.
lines.zh: : 很可能都已经发生了。

lines.en: scene karincat29
: Already?...
: What do you mean by already?
lines.zh: : 您说已经，是什么意思？

lines.en: : I mean that Kirin and I might already be “involved.”
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，我和 Kirin 也许已经「有那种关系」了。

lines.en: : But I don’t think it would be good for you two if you were to mention knowing that.
lines.zh: : 但我觉得，如果你让她知道你清楚这件事，对你俩都不好。

lines.en: : I kind of didn’t want to tell you anything in the first place, but...you’re her sister. So you have the right to know.
lines.zh: : 我本来一点也不想告诉你，不过……你是她姐姐。所以你有权知道。

lines.en: : What...what do you mean by “already?”
lines.zh: : 什、什么叫「已经」？

lines.en: : What...what did you do to her?
lines.zh: : 您……您对她做了什么？

lines.en: : “With” her. Not to her.
lines.zh: : 是「和她」，不是「对她」。

lines.en: : That’s a completely different thing.
lines.zh: : 这是完全不同的两回事。

lines.en: : It’s not like I’m taking advantage of her. If anything, she came onto me.
lines.zh: : 我又不是在占她便宜。要说的话，是她先扑上来的。

lines.en: Well, I came onto her as well, but-
lines.zh: 嗯，我也扑上去过，不过——

lines.en: Yeah.
lines.zh: 算了。

lines.en: scene karincat30
: S...Sorry...this is just a bit of a shock to me...
lines.zh: : 抱、抱歉……这对我有点太突然了……

lines.en: : Hahah...hah...
: This...this is what I get for poking my nose in stuff that’s not my business, right?
lines.zh: : 这……这就是我多管闲事的下场，对吧？

lines.en: scene karincat31
: Hahah...hahahaha!
lines.zh: : 哈哈……哈哈哈哈！

lines.en: : The...the best part is that...I never would have found out if she’d have just shown up today.
lines.zh: : 最……最好笑的是……如果她今天来了，我永远都不会知道。

lines.en: scene karincat32
: You’ll be good to her at least...right?...
lines.zh: : 至少您会对她好的……对吧？……

lines.en: : She can be mean at times, but she’s such a sweet girl...
lines.zh: : 她有时候是挺坏的，但她真的是个好女孩……

lines.en: : And she has so much love to give...
lines.zh: : 而且她有那么多的爱可以付出……

lines.en: : I’m glad she...she finally found someone who...she wants to...
lines.zh: : 我很高兴她……她终于找到了一个她想……

lines.en: scene karincat33
: Already?...
: Really?...
lines.zh: : 真的吗？……

lines.en: : How is that fair?...
lines.zh: : 凭什么啊？……

lines.en: : I...haven’t even...
lines.zh: : 我……都还没……

lines.en: Karin trails off before she finishes her last thought, but it’s pretty clear which direction it was headed in.
lines.zh: Karin 话没说完就没了声，不过那句话朝哪个方向走，相当明显。

lines.en: Kirin got the jump on her and it broke her in the process.
lines.zh: Kirin 抢先了一步，而这个过程把她击垮了。

lines.en: Or saved her, depending on how you look at it.
lines.zh: 或者说是救了她，取决于你怎么看。

lines.en: And she can’t even feel properly betrayed since she never made an effort to do anything about her own feelings in the first place.
lines.zh: 而她甚至没法正经地感到被背叛，因为她从一开始就没为自己的感情做过任何努力。

lines.en: Honesty hurts sometimes.
lines.zh: 诚实有时候很伤人。

lines.en: In fact, honesty hurts most of the time.
lines.zh: 事实上，诚实大多数时候都很伤人。

lines.en: And all of those people who tell you honesty is the best policy-
lines.zh: 而那些告诉你诚实是上策的人——

lines.en: They’re going to really hurt someone one day.
lines.zh: 总有一天会狠狠伤到某个人。

lines.en: But they’ll be too high up on the pedestals they craft of their comrades' bones to ever even notice.
lines.zh: 但他们站在用同伴骨头堆成的神坛上太高了，永远都不会注意到。

lines.en: I look down at Karin from atop my pedestal.
lines.zh: 我从自己的神坛上低头看着 Karin。

lines.en: And can’t help but wonder how much longer it will take for her senseless crying to cease.
lines.zh: 忍不住想知道，她这毫无意义的哭泣还要多久才会停。

lines.en: scene karincat34
: Hah...if it were any colder out here, I think my tears would freeze.
lines.zh: : 哈……要是再冷一点，我的眼泪大概要冻住了。

lines.en: : Karin...
lines.zh: : Karin……

lines.en: : If you’re worried about me telling anyone...don’t be.
lines.zh: : 如果您担心我说出去……不用担心。

lines.en: : Unless you hurt her.
lines.zh: : 除非您伤害她。

lines.en: : If you break my little sister’s heart...I’ll...I’ll do something about it.
lines.zh: : 如果您伤了我妹妹的心……我会……我会做点什么的。

lines.en: : I have no idea what, but...don’t mess with me...
lines.zh: : 我不知道是什么，不过……别惹我……

lines.en: scene karincat35
: G-Got it...Sensei?
lines.zh: : 听、听到了吗……Sensei？

lines.en: : I’d be a little more intimidated if you had pepper spray.
lines.zh: : 你要是有防狼喷雾，我会更害怕一点。

lines.en: : Looks like I’m stopping at the convenience store on the way back, then...
lines.zh: : 看来我回去路上得顺道去趟便利店了……

lines.en: : Do you, um...
lines.zh: : 那个，您……

lines.en: : Do you know if Kirin is coming home tonight?
lines.zh: : 您知道 Kirin 今晚回不回家吗？

lines.en: : No clue. I haven’t seen her today.
lines.zh: : 不知道。我今天没见过她。

lines.en: : Then she probably wants you to go look for her...
lines.zh: : 那她大概是想让您去找她……

lines.en: : Nah. I’m sure she’s just with her friends or something.
lines.zh: : 不了。我敢肯定她只是跟朋友在一起什么的。

lines.en: : Heh...looks like you’ve still got a lot to learn...
lines.zh: : 呵……看来您要学的还多着呢……

lines.en: scene black
Karin gathers her things and begins to walk away.
lines.zh: Karin 收拾好东西，开始走开。

lines.en: She doesn’t say goodbye, but that’s probably because she starts sobbing the second her eyes break contact with mine.
lines.zh: 她没有道别，不过大概是因为她的目光一离开我的眼睛，就开始抽泣了。

lines.en: Her walk turns into a jog.
lines.zh: 她的走变成了小跑。

lines.en: The jog into a run.
lines.zh: 小跑变成了狂奔。

lines.en: A flier falls out of her bag as she makes a sharp turn around the corner.
lines.zh: 她在拐角处急转弯时，一张传单从包里掉了出来。

lines.en: And I feel it will be slightly longer before the soccer team recruits any new members.
lines.zh: 我觉得足球队要招到新成员，还得再等上一阵子。

lines.en: $ karinlied = False
$ day264 = True
$ karin_love += 1
{i}Karin’s affection somehow increases to [karin_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Karin 的好感度不知怎么提升到了 [karin_love]！{/i}

lines.en: {i}But she cries the whole way home.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}但她一路哭着回家。{/i}

lines.en: {i}She really liked you.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}她是真的很喜欢你。{/i}

lines.en: jump afterschoolevent
